summary: Comprehensive testing of Finance Expense Module with TWO BOARDS completed. All backend (21/21) and frontend (17/17) tests passed. Expense Budget Board shows master view with categories and monthly breakdown. Cashbook Board shows Credit/Debit with bank accounts.
critical_code_review_comments: ExpenseTab.js well-structured with clear separation of Budget Board and Cashbook Board
Proper color coding: Green for Credit/Income, Red for Debit/Expense
Category dropdown shows all 12 categories with colored dots
Expense To dropdown appears dynamically after category selection with Add New Item option
FY dropdown and Quarter dropdown working correctly
Monthly breakdown (Total/Paid/Balance) displaying for each month in quarter
Category detail view with drill-down working - shows items inside category
Bank account tabs (Current, GST, Savings, Cash in Hand) all functional
Backend expense_routes.py properly implements all CRUD operations with auth checks
seed_data_creation: Test data created: TEST_Client_Payment income (₹50,000 + ₹9,000 tax) and payment to Anbarasan (₹5,000 + ₹900 tax)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Expense Module v2 with TWO BOARDS fully tested. Expense Budget Board: Master view with 12 categories (Salary, Office Expense, CEO, Vendor Payments, Loans & Debts, Tools & Subscriptions, BNI, Tax & Auditing, Mentorship, Events & Networking, Courses & Books, Marketing & Branding), FY/Quarter dropdowns, monthly breakdown (Jan-Mar for Q4). Click category opens detail view with items inside. Cashbook Board: Amount in Account balance, 4 account tabs, Month/Year selector, split Credit/Debit view with Add buttons, colored badges for categories. NO MOCKED APIs.
